decisions.reason: As an adjacent laser workstation still listed into a second year, it likely has enough option value and low enough carrying cost to retain, though its lower web prominence suggests somewhat weaker commitment than the printer lines.
A close-to-core thermal inkjet product with its own page in both years fits the firm's installed-base and service model, so management would likely keep this option open.
The piezo inkjet printer is also close to the established offer and remained prominently marketed across two years, indicating results are at least good enough to continue learning and selling.
Industrial laser marking systems are strategically central to the firm's traceability direction and were highlighted on the home page at launch, so a near-term withdrawal is unlikely.
The newly launched compact laser marking cabin has dedicated-page support and strong fit with the firm's laser portfolio, making it sensible to keep while market feedback is still forming.
Although this lubricant-printing system is more niche, the trade-fair award and strong application fit in industrial marking suggest enough upside to justify keeping the option alive.
